name: keyprobe
title: KeyProbe
description: Visually test every key on your keyboard in a native macOS panel launched from Raycast.
author: yuzu

commands.name: open
commands.title: Open KeyProbe
commands.subtitle: KeyProbe
commands.description: Open the key test panel (focuses the existing panel if already open)

commands.name: search-layout
commands.title: Select Keyboard Layout
commands.subtitle: KeyProbe
commands.description: Search and pick which keyboard layout to test (overrides the Keyboard Layout preference until changed again)

preferences.name: layoutMode
preferences.title: Keyboard Layout
preferences.description: Which board to draw. Auto detects the attached keyboard's hardware type — but that reports ANSI for an ANSI-shaped board even if its firmware sends JIS-mapped combos (英数/かな/¥/_), so force JIS here to test those.

scripts.build-helper: cd swift/keyprobe-helper && swift build -c release --scratch-path ../../.raycast-swift-build/keyprobe-helper && cp ../../.raycast-swift-build/keyprobe-helper/release/KeyProbeHelper ../../assets/KeyProbeHelper
